Instead user will be charged only for the services he/she wants to consume.  Extension to the current applications Earlier micro payments were not a rage because of transaction cost attached to it, which affets the organizations revenue or an individual. But after the introduction of Online wallet and crypto currency the concept of micropayments has become easy.
